scope: Fresh geometry lint of the exact 26 body/word source meshes on the seven-label and six-collar native plates. Intentional glyph contours, recesses and DATA nameplate wings are described per source geometry; deposited strength and finished fit remain physical properties.

step.answer: DATA is the accepted nameplate blank with a 32 mm face width, 1.68 mm depth throughout, and centred jack opening. Its 21.789 mm broad wings project 2.4 mm and have R0.6 ends. Native fit verifies the complete retaining lands and plug approach; physical fit and endurance remain unmeasured.
